## What

<!-- Short summary of what is being done, as a complete sentence written as
     though it were an order ("Delete the FizzBuzz RPC and replace it..."). -->
<!-- Then fill in the details: any supplemental information a reader needs to
     understand the PR holistically — the problem being solved, why this is
     the best approach, shortcomings, bug numbers, benchmark results, and
     links to design documents. -->

## Why

<!-- Why are these changes being made? What context did you have as the
     author? Were there decisions you made that aren't reflected in the
     source code? -->

## Quality Assurance

<!-- Evidence the change works: commands run, test results, screenshots,
     manual verification steps. -->

## References

<!-- Links to related issues, design docs, and prior discussions. Note that
     external links may not be visible to future readers — include enough
     context in the description itself. -->
